title: Levantamento documental, numero do projeto e definicao da quantidade de paineis

project_identity.project_number_rule: Every panel project has one PROJECT_NUMBER. Every downstream artifact must carry PROJECT_NUMBER + PANEL_ID + revision + status.

panel_scope_rules: Determine panel_count from controlled project evidence before panel engineering.
Every panel must have PANEL_ID, function and source reference.
Remote I/O, gateways, field boxes and junction boxes are not additional panels unless controlled project documents classify them as panels.
Conflicting panel count or IDs produce HOLD_SCOPE_CONFLICT.
